name: Goodwood
_about: Written by tools/course/goodwood/to_race_view.py from courses/goodwood-draft.json; don't edit by hand. World axes as Ascot's: x along the home straight (the horses run towards -x), y up, the winning post on the inside rail is the origin. RIGHT-handed (hand 1): each route's rail z 0 on the horses' right, the track on their left, the stands beyond the outer rail (+z) on the home straight. Several routes (each race takes its start's route), each with its own ground heights for the race engine; the ground grid is the real ground under everything.
axes: As Ascot: origin = winning post on the inside rail; y up. On the home straight the horses run towards -x. RIGHT-handed: each route's rail (z = 0) is on the horses' right in that route's running direction, the track runs to z = +trackWidth on their left; on the home straight the stands are beyond (z > trackWidth, south).

path.note: For the race engine: bends as [metres to go where it starts, where it ends, degrees turned (+ towards the rail, - away from it: the left turn into the loop on the 2m4f and 2m5f)]; 'home' = where the home straight starts.
